assets.initial_prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a finished educational illustration inside a beginner-friendly deep-learning notebook, wide landscape 3:2 or 16:9. Title exactly "How a CNN turns pixels into a prediction". Show a clear left-to-right flow, generous spacing, cream background, dark forest-green typography, restrained blue and rust accents. Panel 1 shows a small realistic grayscale ankle boot image on black background, labelled "Image". Panel 2 shows three translucent stacks of image-like grids with visibly different edge responses, labelled "Convolution + ReLU". Panel 3 shows smaller stacked grids, labelled "Pooling". Panel 4 shows a column of numerical features, labelled "Feature vector". Panel 5 shows a small ten-bar score chart with boot bar highlighted, labelled "Classifier". Clear directional arrows connect all five panels. Below the main flow, a subtle bracket under the first four panels labelled "Encoder: learns a representation"; another bracket under classifier labelled "Head: predicts the class". Bottom note exactly "Illustration of the architecture; feature maps and scores are schematic." Accurate teaching: convolution applies learned local filters shared across locations; maps retain spatial layout until pooling/flattening. No assertion that these drawn maps were measured, no fake accuracy, no tiny text, no decorative brain, no overlapping labels. Beautiful concrete image-processing visuals, readable at notebook width.
